name: When should I consider getting an exterior surface condition assessment?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider getting an exterior surface condition assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider an exterior surface condition assessment if you notice visible damage, have recently experienced severe weather, are planning to buy or sell a property, or if your roof is approaching its typical lifespan. It's also beneficial before undertaking major renovations. For example, if you're selling a home in Frisco or McKinney, a current assessment can provide buyers with peace of mind and potentially streamline the sales process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an assessment for visible damage, after severe weather, when buying or selling, or if your roof is old.
